## Beacon Financial Corporation Announces Leadership Appointments


November 19, 2026


***Sumant Pustake Named Chief Operating Officer***


***Peter R. Bakkala Named Chief Internal Audit Officer***


BOSTON, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Beacon Financial Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tXt5MWRdtXvkBYmNCuoP6FeprweFyivLMouCwCIvLw34bMoCKkC4LjfWDMJae-ePTVEpvq7to6zPilcLwgReN3v9r1Y75x4HeDSlAdTMhEdRjsaD-A5n60etGHhyl0S1) (NYSE: BBT) (the “Company”), the holding company of[Beacon Bank](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tXt5MWRdtXvkBYmNCuoP6EpttpUoqua9FSusVb_pESq7ucKaojkv3E1nhBcCpLmG-HCby9WHrWvlMUo9SwgrfQ==) (the “Bank”), today announced the appointments of Sumant Pustake to the role of Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately, and Peter R. Bakkala to the role of Chief Internal Audit Officer effective November 30, 2026.


*Sumant Pustake*


As Chief Operating Officer, Mr. Pustake will be responsible for leading the execution of the Bank’s strategic priorities and overseeing enterprise program management, with a focus on driving revenue growth, optimizing expenses and improving operational efficiency. His responsibilities will span enterprise product strategy and management, digital strategy, enterprise data and analytics, artificial intelligence strategy, incentive compensation analytics, and all facets of client experience, including Call Center operations. He will also oversee initiatives to strengthen client engagement, enhance the Bank’s customer-facing capabilities and support its long-term growth objectives. Mr. Pustake will report to Chief Executive Officer Sean Gray.


Mr. Pustake has nearly 20 years of banking experience, including 10 years in commercial banking and credit. He most recently served as Chief Digital & Data Officer at Beacon Bank and previously as Chief Strategy & Marketing Officer at Berkshire Bank, where he led corporate strategy, transformation, product management, marketing and digital banking. Throughout his career, he has a record of elevating performance, rationalizing expenses, supporting acquisitions and divestitures, and driving digital modernization and deposit growth. He holds an MBA from Yale School of Management, a Master of Science in Finance from Clark University and a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering from Pune University.


“Sumant brings a unique combination of commercial banking experience, strategic leadership and a proven track record of delivering results,” Mr. Gray said. “His appointment strengthens our leadership team as we focus on executing our strategic priorities, improving efficiency and positioning Beacon for long-term growth.”


*Peter R. Bakkala*


As Chief Internal Audit Officer, Mr. Bakkala will be responsible for leading all aspects of Beacon’s internal audit and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) testing programs. He will provide independent and objective assurance to management and the Audit Committee on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance and internal controls that support the achievement of organizational objectives. In addition, he will promote and facilitate the continuous improvement of controls. Mr. Bakkala will report directly to the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors and administratively to CEO Sean Gray.


Mr. Bakkala’s banking career spans 40 years, most recently having served as Chief Risk Officer at Needham Bank. Over his career, he has held senior leadership roles at Citizens Financial Group, including President of Government & Professional Banking, Chief Compliance Officer and Audit Director. He has also worked with Bank of America, Fleet and was a Principal at KPMG. Mr. Bakkala received his Ph.D. in Business Administration from Northcentral University, a Master of Arts in Economics & Finance from Trinity College and a Bachelor of Arts in Economics from Connecticut College. He also holds CIA and CISA certifications. Over many years, Mr. Bakkala has served on the boards of the Connecticut College Alumni Association, Labouré College, Special Olympics Massachusetts, and the Board of Advisors for the Greater Boston Food Bank. He enjoys serving as an adjunct professor in the business school at Regis College.


“Peter joins us with deep financial institution executive experience and a long record of strengthening risk and control environments,” added Mr. Gray. “He brings an objective external perspective and the rigor our Audit Committee and Board expect. His judgment and independence will help ensure that as we move with greater speed, we do so with discipline, integrity and the trust of our clients and shareholders.”


**ABOUT BEACON FINANCIAL CORPORATION**
Beacon Financial Corporation (NYSE: BBT) is the holding company for Beacon Bank & Trust, commonly known as Beacon Bank, a full-service regional bank serving the Northeast. Headquartered in Boston, the Company has $21.9 billion in assets and more than 145 branches throughout New England and New York. Beacon Bank offers a full suite of tailored banking solutions including commercial, cash management, asset-based lending, retail, consumer and residential products and services. The Company also provides equipment financing through its Eastern Funding subsidiary, SBA lending through its 44 Business Capital division, and private wealth services through Beacon Bank and Clarendon Private.
